sentences.en: Excuse me, could you please show me your driving licence?
sentences.zh: 打扰一下，请出示您的驾驶证可以吗？

sentences.en: He didn't get a driving licence until he was twenty-eight.
sentences.zh: 他直到二十八岁才拿到驾照。

sentences.en: He got his driving licence in less time than anyone.
sentences.zh: 他在比任何人都短的时间内拿到了驾照。

senses.zh: 许可证，执照；特许权，批准
